## Experience

- **NICE Actimize**, Software Engineer, R&D, Agentic AI for Fraud Detection (Oct 2025 – Jul 2026). Co-designed and later solely owned a report engine that turns a single SQL query into a deployable agent; ~50 agents built on it, 5 shipped to production. Solely owned an anomalous-activity agent and a live configuration system in production. Designed the SQL schema for agent configurations and report definitions. Wrote Helm charts and resource limits for agent services on Kubernetes.
- **Huupe**, Software Engineer Intern (Summers 2023, 2024). Architected a distributed WebSocket messaging layer on Redis Pub/Sub across multiple Node.js API instances; built the backend API for a smart basketball hoop and refactored 50+ blocking calls to async.

## Projects

- **Avalution** (UCSB Capstone with Ava Labs, Go): stores authenticated blockchain state as a Merkle trie directly on disk; 40% faster than LevelDB on an 80/20 read/write workload. Owned the disk manager, revision manager, and a power-of-two free-list allocator.
- **Cetacean Distribution Modeling** (with Scripps Institution of Oceanography, R): spatio-temporal GLMMs fusing acoustic, visual, and eDNA data; Best Data Methods Award.
